description: This file defines the 'EndpointAwareReport' interface within the OrangeHRM project. The interface specifies methods for preparing filter parameters, obtaining validation rules, and checking report accessibility, all in the context of API endpoint interactions for reporting functionalities.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns a FilterParams object based on the given EndpointProxy instance.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns a collection of parameter validation rules for the filter parameters, based on the provided EndpointProxy.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the report is accessible through the given EndpointProxy; throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.
